pages.dateCard: 5Two Examples From The ArchiveRead The Super’s Codes In ContextStart with the two-letter chart stamp when it survives. Joe’s Fender amplifier decoder uses A for 1951 in the year position and covers stamps used until about 1970. A printed circuit code is a separate kind of information. Fender amp serials don’t reliably establish the production year.Next collect the speaker and transformer markings, keeping all four speakers separate on a Super Reverb. A single changed speaker may have a much later date than the other components. The control-pot reference adds another check when those markings are safely documented by a technician.220014A Speaker Code On The 1960 SuperThe six-digit frame stamp is readable in Joe’s photograph. Any trailing mark is excluded from the transcription.
